svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut one 160 mm length of 60 x 60 x 5 angle; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flat leg (on the stiffener): two 11 mm holes on its centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 33 mm from the corner face, 20 mm from each end (120 mm apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure two stiffener bolts on your bin at a sheet seam first and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: move these holes to match them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Standing leg (sticks out from the wall): two 11 mm holes 20 and 47 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the back of the flat leg, 2 mm below the middle of the length.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: undo the two stiffener bolts, put the bracket on and refit them

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with bolts of the same grade 10 mm longer. No new holes in the bin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The stay bolts to the face of the standing leg away from the flat leg.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the standing leg points straight out from the wall, level.
